_comment: S1344 - named product sectors over the class catalog. Hand-authored input, version-controlled; dev/CATALOG/<module>.jsonl stays a gitignored generated index. Precedence when stamping a class: overrides, then classMatches, then pathMatches. Patterns are PowerShell -like wildcards matched against the catalog 'class' and 'path' fields. Full coverage is not a goal: a class no sector claims simply gets no sector.
